$comment: Single source of truth for the Content-Security-Policy. BaseLayout emits it as a <meta> tag (security/csp.mjs drops the header-only directives), docs/security/cloudflare.md quotes it for the Cloudflare header, and scripts/check-csp.mjs checks the built site against it. When the boot script in src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro changes, run `npm run build && npm run check:csp`: the check prints the new hash. Paste it into script-src below and update the docs line, which the check also verifies.
